```sh

git fetch origin 1b63091d6cbdbb921e2f01ecce18a7298099acab && git checkout 1b63091d6cbdbb921e2f01ecce18a7298099acab

```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

The title line "an orphan adoption moves each adopted object's registry owner and definition to the target package in the same request (ADR-0070 D5)", and a "What stays as before" list that matches the pinned table. |
| Seat's read of the diff | The object limb is synchronous end to end: `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` unregisters the sentinel, then `applyRegistryWriteThrough`'s `object` branch calls `applyObjectRegistryMutation` and returns before that method's first `await`. So the header's "no request sees the name unowned" holds on this head. Only an `active` row is handed over; a name another package owns or extends keeps its owner. |

| Hot file | `protocol.ts`'s `reassignOrphanedMetadata` region. PR #23683 (#23630) is in the promote doors, a different region; whichever lands second takes the other through the queue's merge. #23514 resumes in `classifyObjectContribution`; this PR builds no re-key primitive for it to reuse. |
| Gates | The dev's derived union at this head: 67 commands, 67 × exit 0, `--ran` reconciled. CI was still running at this read. Landing needs every check green or on the expected-skip roster, and `main`'s full battery green (the lane's main-red #23679 is in flight). |

**Residual, accepted.** If `registerObject` threw after the sentinel's unregister, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`'s best-effort warn would leave the name unregistered until a restart. The body registered is the one the sentinel already held, so no input path to that throw was found, and the boot re-registers the object under Q. No code is owed for it.
